definitions.gloss: bargain item; sale item; special-offer product
definitions.explanation: A product being sold at a reduced price during a special sale or promotion. Composed of {特売|とくばい} (special sale) + {品|ひん} (item).

examples.english: I'm going to buy sale items.

examples.japanese: ⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{特売品|とくばいひん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{売|う}り{切|き}れる→売り切れる：03012_urikireru⟧。
examples.english: The sale items at the supermarket sell out quickly.

examples.japanese: ⟦チラシ→チラシ：23406_chirashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{載|の}っている→載る：27882_noru⟧{特売品|とくばいひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目当|めあ}て→目当て：13648_meate⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早く：02935_hayaku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧がいた。
examples.english: There were people lining up from early morning, hoping to get the sale items advertised in the flyer.

notes:
USAGE:
{特売品|とくばいひん} is commonly seen in supermarkets, department stores, and electronics shops. Items are often advertised in ⟦チラシ→チラシ：23406_chirashi⟧ (flyers) or on ⟦{店頭|てんとう}→店頭：12488_tentou⟧ (in-store) displays. The compound breaks down as ⟦{特売|とくばい}→特売：04277_tokubai⟧ (special sale) + ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (item/goods).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {特売品|とくばいひん}⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧ (bargain section)
- {特売品|とくばいひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{狙|ねら}う→狙う：00313_nerau⟧ (go after sale items)
- ⟦{本日|ほんじつ}→本日：09643_honjitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{特売品|とくばいひん} (today's specials)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{特売|とくばい}→特売：04277_tokubai⟧ is the sale event itself.
- ⟦{目玉商品|めだましょうひん}→目玉商品：08064_medamashouhin⟧ refers to a featured sale item used as a draw.
- ⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧ means discount.
